name: Simulate Binaural
description: Simulate binaural room impulse responses, an HRTF per path and per delay line: image sources, optional edge diffraction around obstacles and at the edges of the room's boundary that open wider than 180 deg, and a directional feedback delay network tail. Needs the worker (Python >= 3.11) and a closed room. Writes the responses to the impulse response graph under 'binaural'.

inputParameters.name: tail
inputParameters.description: Decay target of the tail: auto (reference if given, else ray_tracing), reference, ray_tracing (its own ray-traced reference), eyring or sabine (predicted, no simulation).

inputParameters.name: reference
inputParameters.description: Optional reference for the tail: connect the mono_ir_graph output of Simulate Mono (the wire also makes Grasshopper run the ray tracing first).

inputParameters.name: ism_order
inputParameters.description: Highest image source order in the early field.

inputParameters.name: diffraction
inputParameters.description: Edge diffraction around obstacles and at the edges of the room's boundary that open wider than 180 deg: none (default), udfa, or btms (slow).

inputParameters.name: late_envelope
inputParameters.description: Shape the late field: its level per band to the reference's late energy, and each delay line to its direction's share of the ray-traced energy (default True; off for an Eyring or Sabine tail).

inputParameters.name: seed
inputParameters.description: Seed of the feedback matrices and delay jitter; the same seed gives Simulate Binaural and Simulate Ambisonics the same late field. Empty (default): a new random seed each run, shown in the component's message. A number: the same scene gives the same responses.

inputParameters.name: normalize
inputParameters.description: Whether the impulse responses are peak-normalized (default True). The raw level is always kept.

inputParameters.name: hrtf
inputParameters.description: HRTF set of the binaural format. Empty: KEMAR (default). Connect a File Path to a .sofa file to use your own HRTF set; the component's message names the set in use.

inputParameters.name: run
inputParameters.description: Press to simulate. The simulation takes seconds to minutes and Grasshopper recomputes on every upstream change, so it runs only when this is true; a button is added when it is not connected. Without it, the responses already on the scene's graph are passed on.

outputParameters.name: binaural_ir_graph
outputParameters.description: IR graph of the binaural responses (under 'binaural'), for Deconstruct IR Graph and Auralise.
